description: Teres minor is a slender rotator cuff cord that braces the back of the shoulder while adding a crisp ridge above teres major for artists to stage the scapular border.
actions: Laterally rotates the humerus, balancing the cuff against powerful internal rotators.
Assists with adduction when the arm is slightly abducted, helping tuck the elbow toward the flank.
Stabilizes the glenohumeral joint by compressing the humeral head into the glenoid.
